node.title: Re: Almost certainly a module documentation issue
node.author: 1nickt
node.doctext:
Hi, the doc for [metamod://Email::Sender::Transport::Print] is indeed sparse, but it does say:

By default, it will print to STDOUT, but it can be given any IO::Handle object to print to as its fh attribute.

You don't appear to be using [metamod://IO::Handle] to create your filehandle. Have you tried that, or allowing the default?


The way forward always starts with a minimal test.
